 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant P as Host parent
 participant I as Container PID 1
 participant W as Workload group
 participant K as Linux kernel
 P->>I: Forward the received shutdown signal
 I->>W: Forward signal to process group
 alt Application finishes within grace period
 W-->>I: Exit status
 I->>I: Reap workload
 I-->>P: Init process exits
 else Deadline expires
 P->>I: SIGKILL
 I->>K: Namespace init terminates
 K->>W: Kill remaining namespace members
 K-->>P: Init can be reaped
 end
 P->>P: Clean resources and persist stopped state",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
